name: O-RAN SC SMO VES Collector
description: O-RAN VES (Virtual Event Streaming) collector with Grafana dashboard and InfluxDB persistence for collecting VES events from O-RAN components.

docker_support.docker_evidence: makes use of three containers, the ves-collector container that collects VES events, Grafana for display, and InfluxDB

eval_notes: 3-container docker-compose for O-RAN VES event collection and visualization. Simple setup for testing O-RAN SMO monitoring and event-driven workflows.
